Plumbing and electrical repairs in Perth Hills & Swan Valley

For Perth Hills and Swan Valley properties, include the suburb and any driveway, gate, site-contact or access detail that is relevant to the repair visit. Keep electrical, hot-water, drainage and leak symptoms separate.

Plumbing repairs, drainage and hot water

For Perth Hills and Swan Valley bookings, the repair request should connect the reported issue with the equipment location and practical site access. Our hot-water repair and replacement service assesses the equipment, water connections and relevant electrical requirements, whether the unit is beside the home or in another accessible service area.

Visible moisture does not by itself identify a broken pipe. Our water leak detection service investigates the affected area and explains any access work required to establish the source. For an active damaged pipe or connection, our burst pipe repairs service addresses the reported water flow within the agreed repair scope.

Slow or backed-up fixtures are assessed through blocked drain clearing and repair. Describe which fixtures are affected and whether the symptoms are recurring. This page does not assume a particular drainage system, water source or property construction merely from the region name; the installation at your address determines the scope.

Electrical repairs and installation

Our electrical fault finding and repair service covers reported outages and faults in the property installation. Identify affected rooms or separate equipment areas from a safe position. We distinguish the fault being investigated from planned changes to lighting, outlets or equipment connections.

For recurring trips, request safety switch and RCD assessment rather than repeatedly resetting the device. Let us know about visible water, damaged equipment or inaccessible service areas when booking. Do not enter a hazardous area, open covers or touch wet electrical equipment. Move clear and call 000 for immediate danger.

Work is carried out by appropriately licensed plumbing and electrical trades. Licence details are available on request. Our Perth team has an independent office and repair team within Ellis Services Group.

Written quote before work proceeds

Equipment location, access, existing connections and the confirmed fault affect the written quote. Investigation, repair and replacement options are identified separately, with additional pipework, cabling or access work described where required. No equipment package or system type is assumed before assessment.

Our team explains the recommended scope and written price before approved work proceeds. If findings require additional work, that change is discussed first. The handover records what was completed and any remaining item outside the approved scope, helping owners and managers plan the next step clearly.

What to include in a repair request

Include driveway, gate and on-site contact information relevant to the visit, plus the location of the affected equipment. If access to a separate building or locked service area is required, identify who can provide entry. These details support visit planning without asking you to inspect or test equipment yourself.

For a managed property, include the work order, occupant contact and approval pathway. Keep distinct faults as separate items, especially where plumbing and electrical work are both requested. Photos are optional and can be sent by email only when safely taken.

Call 0413 477 667 or request an on-site assessment and written quote. You do not need to diagnose the fault before making contact.

Suburbs within this service region

Choose your suburb to prefill the property location in our contact form: Ellenbrook, Aveley, The Vines, Henley Brook, Brabham, Caversham, Swan View, Stratton, Jane Brook, Bellevue, Greenmount, Darlington, Mundaring, Kalamunda, Lesmurdie, Gooseberry Hill, Walliston, Pickering Brook, Parkerville, Chidlow.

See all six Perth service regions for our wider coverage.

Perth Hills & Swan Valley plumber and electrician FAQ

Describe the property route and equipment location

Include the complete address, the appropriate driveway or entry point and any known access restriction. If the equipment is outside or in a separate building, describe its location without entering a hazard. Tanks, pumps, private wastewater systems and other specialist infrastructure are not automatically included in a general repair request; confirm the specific task first.

  • Plumbing service scope
  • Electrical repairs and installation scope
  • Check the listed Perth service areas
Does this regional guide include every rural or private system?

No. Provide details of the equipment and the proposed work. A regional service enquiry does not confirm specialist tank, pump, septic or other infrastructure work, and availability must be checked for the actual address.

What should a Hills or Swan Valley repair request include?

Include the property address, access details, service type and a concise description of the issue.

How should an electrical concern be described safely?

Share observable changes and affected areas without opening equipment or approaching a hazard.
